Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. In less than a decade, we've built a nationally recognized brand and a proprietary AI and automation stack that make us one of the largest and most efficient providers of legal services in the country. Our growth runs on a culture of excellence, compassion, and results: Our team is committed to exceptional client experience and to supporting one another in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. We invest in our people, encourage professional growth, and provide meaningful opportunities to build rewarding careers while making a real impact in our clients' lives.

**Pay Scale:** $130,000–$165,000 per year (base pay)

**Work arrangement:** On-site

**Reports to:** Chief Technology Officer

**The Role**
------------

**Build full-stack apps with AI inside them and own them in production.**

Technology is part of how we practice law. Systems we built and run ourselves read and sort more than 100,000 incoming documents and transcribe more than 100,000 calls every month, chase medical records, and put each case's full history in front of the people working it. We have replaced seven figures of vendor software with our own systems, and we keep adding more.

You will build the internal apps our staff work in every day, from the screen to the service and database behind it, and add AI where it saves real time. You own features end to end: learn the work from the people who do it, build the fix, test it, ship it, and watch it in production.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Build full-stack features.** React and Next.js screens, Node/TypeScript and Python services, and Postgres, for apps like our records console, claims console and case assistant.
* **Build AI features.** Document extraction, classification and routing, search across case files, and agents that take actions with a person approving the result.
* **Connect the firm's systems.** Integrate with Salesforce/Litify, Outlook and SharePoint (Microsoft Graph), Zoom, Twilio and DocuSign.
* **Test before you ship.** Automated tests for your code, and evaluation sets for AI changes that measure facts captured, facts missed, wrong answers, cost and speed.
* **Run what you build.** Deploy containerized services on Azure, monitor them, and fix them when they break.
* **Learn the work first.** Sit with intake, case management, records and litigation staff before building, and train them on what you ship.
* **Write it down.** Document each system so someone else on the team can run it.

**Qualifications**
------------------

***Required***

* 3 to 5 years building production software, full-stack: React or Next.js plus Node/TypeScript or Python.
* SQL and Postgres.
* At least one LLM-powered feature shipped to real users: prompt design, tool use, structured outputs or retrieval.
* Integrations built on REST APIs and webhooks.
* Git, code review and Docker, plus cloud deployment experience (Azure preferred).
* Care with sensitive data, and the ability to explain technical work in plain language.

***Preferred***

* Anthropic Claude or OpenAI APIs; agent frameworks or MCP.
* Supabase and vector search with pgvector.
* n8n or another workflow automation platform.
* Salesforce APIs and SOQL; Litify.
* Voice AI or telephony (Retell, Twilio, Zoom).
* Legal, insurance or healthcare data.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* **First month:** You ship a production improvement to one of our apps.
* **90 days:** You own one feature area end to end, with tests, monitoring and a runbook.
* **12 months:** Something you built is part of staff's daily routine, with its hours saved measured.

**Our Stack**
-------------

Python, TypeScript/Node, Next.js/React, Postgres and Supabase with pgvector, Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs, Azure Container Apps and Docker, n8n, MCP, Salesforce/Litify, Microsoft 365 and the Graph API, Zoom, Twilio, Retell, GitHub.

**About EgoFold**
-----------------

Snail Games USA is a global developer and publisher of interactive digital entertainment, dedicated to creating innovative and immersive gaming experiences. Since 2009, Snail Games has been committed to pushing the boundaries of technology, creativity, and interactive entertainment.

As part of our continued investment in emerging technologies, Snail Games is expanding its capabilities in artificial intelligence, intelligent systems, and advanced software development.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory.

**About the job**

This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves.

You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first-class part of the work.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets.
* Own the retrieval path that answers "what do we know about this person?" in milliseconds, working with embeddings, vector search, and ranking
* Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships.
* Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces.
* Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

**Required:**

* Experience building backend services, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages, frameworks, and tools as the problem demands.
* A curious approach to service management: ability to investigate how systems actually behave in production, and desire to continuously learn how to operate them with rigor and accountability.
* Experience building or working with evaluation/quality-measurement systems, such as regression detection or quality metrics, or the desire to learn.
* Solid grounding in observability practices: structured logging, metrics, and using them to debug distributed systems in production.
* Fluency with AI-assisted dev tools (e.g. agents for code generation, review, debugging), applied with deliberate direction and critical thinking.

**Desired:**

* Experience with Go and/or Python.
* Experience with event-streaming systems (e.g. Kafka).
* Experience building LLM-backed products.
* Practical experience applying ML, e.g. building, evaluating, or productionizing models.

**Location**

* This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas.

**Travel**

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

**What We Offer**

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

**Compensation**

* *Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.*

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

* Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $128,560 - $160,700
* Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $136,000 - $170,000.
* This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 13, but may change based on business needs.
